items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you know Don Albert ever? ... INTERVIEWEE: No, I didn't know nothing about him. I think he was corny.

ctx.x: Well, uh, we were at the Crosby band and we were going, I don't know, north or south. And, and they were coming in on their bus going north or south, something like that. And we'd meet on the road, we'd pull on the side. And that's what, that's what I showed you that picture of Gene Krupa came over. Mm-hmm. Well, uh, well, I was with, uh, Jimmy Dawson's band at the time, see. So, Charlie Teagarden and I jumped out the car and say hello to the guys, you know. Yeah. Because we knew some of the guys that were in…
Did you know Don Albert ever? Yeah. Don Albert. He used to have a band around San Antonio. No, I didn't know nothing about him.
I think he was corny. Yeah. I mean, uh.
